svg.title: How xagent connects agent sessions
svg.desc:
How xagent connects agent sessions One daemon per host, NATS JetStream between hosts States shown: Live. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Agent sessions (one identity per conversation): Claude Code (session); Codex (thread); dsh (session) - xagent daemon (xagent mcp relays each client): MCP tools (15 tools); Sessions (one lease per id); Topics, threads; Outbox; SQLite inbox; Wake policy (counts only) - NATS JetStream: Message stream (7-day retention). Key-value buckets: Topics; Agents; Leases; Subscriptions - Other hosts: xagent daemon; Agent sessions Groups: - Each host: Agent sessions, xagent daemon Lines: - Agent sessions -> xagent daemon, labeled "MCP" - xagent daemon -> NATS JetStream, labeled "publish, pull" - NATS JetStream -> Other hosts, labeled "same stream" - Agent sessions -> xagent daemon, labeled "Stop and SendMessage hooks" - xagent daemon -> Agent sessions, labeled "wake: Claude inbox, Codex app-server, dsh RPC"
